description.zh: 模板内容。JSON或YAML格式，长度限制为 64 KB。
description.en: The content of the template. The content must be in the JSON or YAML format, and its maximum size is 64 KB.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 标签键和值列表， 标签键值对数量范围是1至20。
description.en: The tag keys and tag values. The number of key-value pairs ranges from 1 to 20.

description.zh: 模板名称。内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度200字符，且不能以ALIYUN、ACS、ALIBABA、ALICLOUD开头。
description.en: The name of the template. The name can be 1 to 200 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, or ALICLOUD.
The name of the version of the template.
